text: A股三大指数今日涨跌不一，截至收盘，上证指数涨0.28%，深证成指涨0.15%，创业板指跌0.14%，北证50跌0.41%，科创50指数跌0.69%。全市场成交额18731亿元，较上日缩量1052亿元，全市场超3600只个股下跌。板块题材上，煤炭开采加工、培育钻石、港口航运、元件、贵金属板块涨幅居前；文化传媒、游戏、AI语料、短剧游戏、AI视频板块跌幅居前。盘面上，煤炭开采加工板块全天强势，云煤能源、郑州煤电、大有能源涨停，华阳股份、晋控煤业、山煤国际涨幅居前。贵金属板块午后拉升，湖南黄金触及涨停，中金黄金、晓程科技、兴业银锡涨幅居前。港口航运板块低开高
text_en: A-share three major indices ended mixed today; at close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.28%, Shenzhen Component rose 0.15%, ChiNext fell 0.14%, Beijing Stock Exchange 50 fell 0.41%, and STAR 50 fell 0.69%. Total market turnover reached 1,873.1 billion yuan, down 105.2 billion from the previous session, with over 3,600 stocks falling across the market. By sector theme, coal mining and processing, lab-grown diamonds, port shipping, components, and precious metals led gains; cultural media, gaming, AI corpus, short-drama gaming, and AI video led losses. On the board, the coal mining and processing sector was strong all day, with Yunmei Energy, Zhengzhou Coal Industry, and Dayou Energy hitting limit up, while Huayang Shares, Jinneng Holding Coal Industry, and Shanxi Coal International led gains. Precious metals rallied in the afternoon, with Hunan Gold touching limit up, while Zhongjin Gold, Xiaocheng Technology, and Inner Mongolia Xingye Silver and Tin led gains.
